errorCodes.meaning: The signer is not an active member of this community.

Audience.description:
Who may see a directory field, ordered from narrowest to widest. `admins`: holders of `vtc.directory.admin` (and, for derived fields, `vtc.members.manage`). `groups`: members who share at least one community group with the subject (narrowed to the groups the subject names in `groupAudience`, where it names any). `connections`: members holding an attributed, in-force verified relationship with the subject at the community. `members`: every active member. `public`: anyone, and what the member's signed public card carries outside the community.

`groups` and `connections` are not a chain: a viewer sees a field when they satisfy the audience the subject chose for it or any wider audience. Every audience includes the administrators, and the subject always sees their own whole card. There is no `onlyMe`: a value nobody else should see is not directory data.
Audience.title: Audience

CardBlobRef.description: A content-addressed image held in the community's blob store — an avatar or an `image` field. At most 256 KiB, images only, re-encoded by the community on upload (vtc/directory/images/upload: metadata stripped, dimensions capped) so its digest does not link the member across communities. A viewer reads the bytes with vtc/directory/images/get, which answers only where the same projection shows the value. `url` and `urlExpiresAt` MAY appear in a projection: a short-lived URL the community checks against the same projection, so a member-only image is never a public URL. A community that does not offer one leaves both out.

mediaType.description: Media type of the stored bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored, re-encoded bytes.

size.description: Size in bytes of the stored bytes.

url.description: Projection only: a URL the viewer can fetch the image from until `urlExpiresAt`.

CardBlobRef.title: CardBlobRef

CardValues.description: A card's stored values, keyed by field. Holds `member`-, `admin`- and `credential`-sourced fields only; derived fields (`role`, `joinedAt`, `did`, `personhood`) are read from the community's own records when a projection is made, never stored here. At most 64 values, and at most 16 KiB serialized excluding the blobs a `CardBlobRef` names.
CardValues.title: CardValues

DigestMultibase.description:
A cryptographic digest as a multibase-encoded multihash — the encoding the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 defines for `digestMultibase`, and the one `did:webvh` uses for its SCID and entry hashes.

Multihash carries the hash algorithm in-band, so the value is self-describing and the wire format survives an algorithm change without a schema revision; multibase does the same for the base encoding, so a verifier never infers base58 from base64url by context. A bare hex string or a `sha-256:`-style prefix hard-codes one algorithm into the wire contract and is non-conforming here.

This definition constrains the *encoding only*. What the digest is computed over is stated by each referencing field, because it differs legitimately: a digest over a JSON document is taken over its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, while a digest over an opaque artifact is taken over its bytes. A field whose input is a JSON document and which does not name a canonicalization is not reproducible.

Restricted to the two multibase headers W3C Controlled Identifiers 1.0 §2.4 normatively requires — `z` (base58btc) and `u` (base64url-no-pad). CID permits others but states that "interoperability is not guaranteed between implementations using such values", and a registry whose purpose is interoperability should not mint digests a conforming verifier may be unable to read. The alphabets are enforced rather than assumed: base58btc excludes 0, O, I and l, and an earlier permissive pattern let three published examples carry digests that were not valid base58 at all. base58btc is RECOMMENDED, for consistency with `did:key` and `did:webvh`.
DigestMultibase.title: DigestMultibase

DirectoryCard.description: A member's own directory record: their values, a visibility for each field, their discoverability and who may ask to be introduced. Returned whole only to its subject. Every other reader receives a `DirectoryEntry`.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. An extension member MUST NOT carry directory data that bypasses the projection.

groupAudience.description: The community groups whose members count as the `groups` audience for this card. Absent: every community group the subject belongs to. A group the subject has left stops counting at once.

revision.description: Incremented on every accepted change to the card, by its subject or by an administrator's assertion.

DirectoryCard.title: DirectoryCard

Discoverability.description: The member's three discoverability decisions, made separately.

external.description: Whether the member publishes a public card — the fields whose visibility is `public`, signed by the member — through the community's trust registry. A second consent, separate from registry-publication consent (`publishConsent`), which it requires. A community that cannot yet publish external cards refuses `true` with `notAvailable`.

search.description: What a member's search may match. `byName`: `displayName` or `nickname`. `exactNickname`: only an exact `nickname`. `off`: nothing. A DID is never a search key for a non-administrator, whatever this says.

Discoverability.title: Discoverability

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ExternalCard.description: Where the member's external card stands. Present on a card exactly when `discoverability.external` is true. `published`: the community is serving the card the member signed, and its trust registry points to it. `awaitingSignature`: the member's `public` values have changed since they signed, so the community has withdrawn the card it was serving and serves none until the member signs the current values (vtc/directory/card/publish). The community never serves a card the member did not sign, and never one that differs from their current `public` values.

cardDigest.description: Present while `published`: digest of the card served, as vtc/directory/card/publish defines it.

publishedAt.description: Present while `published`: when the card now served was published.

ExternalCard.title: ExternalCard

FieldKey.description: Identifier of a directory field. A key with no `.` is a BASE field, the same in every community: `displayName`, `nickname`, `avatar`, `pronouns`, `bio`, `links` (written by the member) and `role`, `joinedAt`, `did`, `personhood` (derived from the community's own records, never stored on a card). A community-defined field MUST use a reverse-DNS key (`org.example.employer`), so a base key never collides with one, and a key is never reused with a different meaning once defined.
FieldKey.title: FieldKey

FieldValue.description: The value of one field. Which shape a field takes is fixed by its definition's `type`: text-like types (`text`, `longText`, `url`, `email`, `phone`, `enum`, `date` as YYYY-MM-DD, `country` as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, `did`) are strings; `multiEnum` and the base field `links` are arrays of strings; `image` and the base field `avatar` are a `CardBlobRef`; `claim` is a `VerifiedValue`; the derived base field `personhood` is a boolean.
FieldValue.title: FieldValue

FieldVisibility.description: The audience the member chose for each field. A field with no entry here takes its definition's `defaultVisibility`. The community MUST NOT widen a member's choice: widening a field's ceiling or default changes no visibility already recorded.
FieldVisibility.title: FieldVisibility

Introductions.description: Who may ask the community to introduce them to this member. `anyone`: any active member who can find the entry. `groups`: only members who share a community group with them. `connections`: only members holding an attributed, in-force verified relationship with them. `off`: nobody. A refused introduction is never reported to its sender.
Introductions.title: Introductions

Listing.description: Whether members can find the entry. `listed`: it appears when members browse. `findable`: it does not appear when browsing, but a search that matches it under `search` returns it. `hidden`: no member finds it by browsing or searching; administrators still see it, and members who share a group that shows its members see it in that group's member list.
Listing.title: Listing

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/card/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/card/show/0.1#response.

missingRequired.description: Required fields the card has no value for. While any is missing the entry is not listed, whatever `discoverability.listing` says.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Card — Show — response payload

VerifiedValue.description: The value of a `credential`-sourced field: a claim the member disclosed from a credential they presented, with the issuer that attests it. A verified value always names its issuer, and a self-asserted value is never shaped as one. The community keeps only the disclosed claim and these facts about it — never the presentation.

credentialType.description: The most specific `type` of the credential the claim came from.

issuer.description: DID of the credential's issuer, shown as the field's verification badge.

validUntil.description: When the credential expires, where it does. The community withdraws the value once it passes.

verifiedAt.description: When the community verified the presentation.

VerifiedValue.title: VerifiedValue
